fonts.usage: Primary UI, chat messages, standard buttons
Channel names, nicknames, online counts, hero heading, random stranger labels

colors.instructions: Use 'background_sidebar' for the left sidebar. Use 'background_chat' for the main chat panel. 'accent_green' is STRICTLY for unread badges and online presence indicators. 'accent_blurple' is for primary CTAs to match the Discord aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism. Stick to solid opaque backgrounds for the chat interface to ensure high legibility and Discord-like performance.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-[#1e1f22]) to separate sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient shadows only for modals, popovers, or floating menus. Main layout should remain flat.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise overlay on the landing page background.

sidebar.behavior: Fixed on desktop, collapsible via hamburger menu on mobile

items.channel_link: flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-[#949ba4] hover:bg-[#313338] hover:text-[#f2f3f5] transition-colors

chat_panel.header: h-14 border-b border-[#1e1f22] flex items-center px-4 bg-[#313338] justify-between
chat_panel.message_feed: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-5 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-[#1e1f22]
chat_panel.message_input: bg-[#383a40] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-[#f2f3f5] placeholder-[#949ba4] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#5865f2] w-full

buttons.primary: bg-[#5865f2] hover:bg-[#4752c4] text-white font-medium px-6 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[#da373c] hover:bg-[#a12828] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#4e5058] hover:bg-[#6d6f78] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors

layouts.landing_page: 100vh flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden. Center the nickname entry card. Set hero background to dim overlay over abstract connection image.
layouts.app_layout: h-screen flex overflow-hidden. Left sidebar (w-72, flex-shrink-0), right chat area (flex-1 flex flex-col).
layouts.transparency_rule: DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Provide solid fallbacks.

motion.hover_states: Buttons and links should have background color transitions (duration 200ms ease).
motion.sidebar_toggle: Slide-in from left for mobile (transform transition).
motion.messages: New messages should smoothly slide up into view. Use subtle entrance animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against the dark backgrounds meets at least AA standards. Muted text should be readable.
accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have explicit focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

images.description: Abstract digital connection - Blue lines and dots
images.usage: Background image for the Landing Page. Wrap in a container with bg-black/80 overlay to keep text highly legible.
Accent image for feature cards on the landing page.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react. Required icons: Hash (channel), Users (online count), Menu (hamburger), Send (message input), SkipForward (random stranger), Flag (report).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize building the Landing page and Chat layout as distinct routes or conditional renders using React router if necessary, or just state management.
Create Javascript components (.jsx/.js files), DO NOT use .tsx files.
Implement the Discord 3-tier dark colors: Sidebar is #2b2d31, Chat area is #313338, Chat header is #313338 with bottom border #1e1f22.
In the Sidebar, group 'General' and 'Section A-R' under a tiny uppercase 'CHANNELS' label with JetBrains Mono.
Pin 'Random Stranger' at the bottom of the sidebar. Give it a distinct icon or separator.
In the Chat Area, show a list of messages. Each message should have the User's Nickname (bold) and timestamp on the top line, and the message content below it. Mimic Discord's compact view.
The 'Green accent' for unread badges MUST be #23a559. Place it next to the channel name in the sidebar for unread states.
The input area should resemble Discord's: a rounded rectangular pill spanning most of the bottom width.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. The chat app layout is strictly 2-column on desktop (sidebar + flex-grow chat).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No text-center on the body or main wrapper.
Always use modern button styles. For the landing page, use pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons with strong contrast.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states for channels, inputs, buttons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
